answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted grading: an agent earns a seat only after locking a bond, and its vote counts in proportion to that bond rather than to the number of identities it controls. Spinning up a trellis of synthetic agents adds no power, since every new node must post its own pearl of collateral. To reach the zenith of influence, an attacker must fund a separate stake for each fake account, so cost climbs linearly with each Sybil while any dishonest vote gets slashed from the bond.
